name: Continual Flame

components.m: ruby dust worth 50+ GP, consumed by the spell

summary: An object sheds a heatless, lasting flame: Bright Light in a 20-ft radius and Dim Light 20 ft beyond.
text: A flame springs from an object you touch, shedding Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for another 20 feet. It looks like ordinary fire but gives off no heat and uses no fuel. It lasts until dispelled; it can be covered or hidden, but not smothered or put out.
